title: CarGeometry - Porsche 964 body-dimension archive and public previews
notes: Access status applies to the public previews only. All 24 displayed images (one photo, 23 technical images) and all eight explicitly linked larger files were reviewed. The selected originals match the 30 October cache; seven corresponding images on cargeometry.com are also byte-identical. Several sheets contain nominal-point/height tables, but a complete reliable transcription of their values, contact symbols and datum conventions has not been obtained. The readable 2272 mm wheelbase label repeats the existing reference and adds no body-interface coordinate. The full archive remains purchase-required and was not acquired; its extra content or resolution is unknown. Body styles and parts-on/parts-removed states are kept separate. No model, CAD, coordinate, scan or redistribution licence is obtained by public viewing. Current audit: twins/964-chassis/preview-extraction-20261104/README.md; image hashes and coverage: inventory.json in that directory. No preview value has been admitted as functional interface geometry.
